snippet.title: Tetris 2 ZX Spectrum
snippet.description:
For those who remember my Tetris video (not many of you but we'll play along anyway) you'll remember that the original was a disappointment, the background got in the way and the drop button was very sensitive.....well there was a sequel from Czechoslovakia and it crushes that version!  This is just a fantastic version of Tetris, it has it's flaws but it's much more enjoyable than Mirrorsoft's version.

So to sum it up - England 0 Czechoslovakia 1.
